//: Composite indexes. WITHOUT THESE THE GRID IS PERMANENTLY EMPTY.
getRevealed() and getTiebreaks() both filter on an equality (wk) plus
an inequality on a different field (revealAt). Firestore refuses that
combination unless a composite index exists, with FAILED_PRECONDITION.
The app catches the rejection and degrades to an empty list, so the
symptom is a Grid and a tiebreak panel that stay blank forever with
nothing on screen to explain why — the failure only appears in the
browser console, which nobody looks at.
Building them takes a minute or two; queries fail until they finish.

indexes.//: myPicks(): two equalities. Firestore can usually merge single-field indexes for this, but declaring it removes the doubt.
